text: Adele Fiona Boone's activities during Week 2010-W42 are flagged due to unusual volume of logons outside her working hours and browsing to job-search sites atypical for an Electrical Engineer. The evidence suggests that she logged on four times outside of normal working hours, which is significantly higher than her typical frequency of 0.5 logons and exceeds the maximum recorded (z=3.5). Additionally, her visits to job-search sites reached 70, which is above her recent typical frequency of 36 and even surpasses the maximum recorded for same-role peers (61) by a wider margin (z=4.17).
